turns.text: how can i integrate with ABDM

must_contain: Integration starts with an application to integrate the digital health solution in the ABDM sandbox
ABDM integration is divided into milestones, and an integrator implements the ones that apply to its software
notes: NHA review of 30 September 2026: 'How can I integrate with ABDM?' was answered as integrating 'through HIE-CM'. ABDM is the umbrella; HIE-CM, UHI and NHCX are its gateways. Source lines: shared.sandbox.first-fifteen-minutes ('you apply to integrate your digital health solution in the sandbox with an online application', as in faq-rephrased-abdm-sandbox-02-c); site/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/index.mdx 'ABDM integration is divided into milestones ... Integrators should implement the milestones applicable to their software'. Routed to the overview shape.
